column.name: PDA_DEVICE_NO
column.description: Globally unique identifier of the mobile device (e.g. 12 digit alphanumeric identification number in case of PDAs, etc.).

column.name: LAST_USER_ID
column.description: FK tlgnc_user_id. The last user who logged in with this PDA device. This is just for informational purposes, but useful to contact the current 'owner' of a device. (Info is redundant to tlgnc_pdf_session, sorted by date per pda device).

column.name: CARRIER_ID
column.description: The carrier that this pda device is assigned to.

column.name: TYPE_DESCRIPTION
column.description: Type of the PDA. Just text, not used by LOGON.

column.name: INVENTORY_NUMBER
column.description: Inventory number (text). Not used by Logon, cannot be used to search for, no unique constraint etc.

column.name: SIMCARD_CD
column.description: FK tlgnr_simcard_bs. SIM-Card/Phone number of the SIM used in this PDA device. The SIM card-phone number programming itself is done by the partner and not meant to be changed by a user or administrator. The SIM-card and phone number info is not used by Logon, it's just for informational purposes (at least for now).

column.name: LAST_REGISTRATION_DATE
column.description: Date when the device was 'registered' (whatever this means for Crh). Not used by Logon, treated as a date without any meaning.

column.name: SOFTWARE_VERSION
column.description: Software version installed on this PDA. Not used by Logon, treated as text without a meaning.

column.name: PDA_DEVICE_COMMENT
column.description: Any comment about the PDA device which does not fit into the other free text fields.
